Actionable expression: stay long the existing 2027H-Z strip.

events.invalidation: BoC delivers the priced 2027 mid-3s path, or trim/median leave 1.9/2.0 while jobs stop contracting.
events.rationale: FACT: As of 2026-09-17 overnight CORRA is 2.29. Tradable CRA 3m implieds are 2.385 (2026-09), 2.775 (2026-12), 3.13 (2027-03, +84bp), 3.365 (2027-06, +107.5bp), 3.51 (2027-09, +122bp) and 3.595 (2027-12, +130.5bp); the equal-weight 2027 H-Z strip marks 3.40 (+111bp). FACT: August CPI headline is 3.0% y/y with CPI-trim 1.9 and CPI-median 2.0; employment -42k, unemployment 6.4% unchanged, average hourly wages +2.0% y/y versus +2.8% in July; CA gauges labor 38, consumer 45, inflation 55, activity 66. FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00; official SOFR jumped to 3.85 on 2026-09-17; SR3 prices 4.315 (2026-12), 4.565 (2027-03), 4.735 (2027-09). FACT: CA 2Y is 3.27 (1y percentile 97.8; 5y 58.5) and CA-US 2Y is -140bp (1y percentile 3.8). INFERENCE: The 2027 CRA strip is pricing an energy-pass-through catch-up hiking cycle that domestic labor and underlying CPI do not require. Restrictive US policy and the already-low 2.29 CORRA overnight should slow Canada further, so 2027 implied CORRA falls rather than being delivered into the mid-3s. UNKNOWN: whether BoC minutes' energy pass-through, Q2 GDP +0.8% q/q, and the two-sided oil news (shock absorbers weaker versus a Saudi/Oman workaround) can still force validation of the strip. CFTC/CME positioning is null/unavailable.
